recentItems.title: Comelec all set for historic BARMM polls
recentItems.description:
Top Story: Commission on Elections Chairman George Erwin Garcia arrived in Cotabato City on Friday (September 11), three days before the first Bangsamoro parliamentary elections, to meet with local officials, police and other election stakeholders. Garcia said the poll body is fully prepared for Monday’s historic polls.

recentItems.title: Sandiganbayan orders transfer of Romualdez to PGH
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: VP Sara: Constitution must guide conviction threshold in impeach trial
recentItems.description:
Top Story: Vice President Sara Duterte said Friday (September 11) that the constitution should be followed on the issue of how many votes are needed for acquittal or conviction in her impeachment trial.

The impeachment court has tapped four retired Supreme Court justices as advisers after Sen. Erwin Tulfo appealed a July 6 ruling that the concurrence of 16 senators or two-thirds of the full 24-member Senate was needed for a conviction. — Report from Harlene Delgado, ABS-CBN News

recentItems.title: Hiyawan at gitgitan: Mga tagpo sa muling pagharap ni VP Sara sa Quezon City RTC
recentItems.description:
Hiyawan ang sumalubong kay Vice President Sara Duterte, kasama ang kapatid nitong si Davao City Rep. Paolo Duterte, sa muli niyang pagharap sa Quezon City Regional Trial Court nitong Biyernes (Setyembre 11) para sa kanyang arraignment sa kasong grave threats.

Hindi natuloy ang nasabing pagbabasa ng sakdal bunsod ng mga mosyong pinag-aaralan pa ng korte, ayon kay Atty. Paul Lawrence Lim, abogado ng bise.
